requirements.title: Intrinsic procedures are divided into eight classes
requirements.definition: Intrinsic procedures are divided into inquiry functions, elemental functions, transformational functions, elemental subroutines, simple subroutines, atomic subroutines, collective subroutines, and impure subroutines.

pending.intrinsic-procedure-eight-classes: Source-use plan: future intrinsic fixtures cite the class named by 16.7/16.9 and use only class-changing mutations that change observable scalar/array, function/subroutine, or image behavior.

requirements.title: Intrinsic function classes are defined by inquiry, elemental, transformational, and simple behavior
requirements.definition: An inquiry function result depends on argument properties rather than values; an elemental function is specified for scalar arguments and may be applied to arrays under 15.9; all other intrinsic functions are transformational; all standard intrinsic functions are simple.

requirements.title: Intrinsic actual arguments require specific names and scalar references
requirements.definition: If an intrinsic procedure is used as an actual argument, its specific name shall be used, it shall be referenced in the called procedure only with scalar arguments, and an intrinsic procedure without a specific name shall not be used as an actual argument.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
